title: Capsule system

reference.grammar: one field of rounded capsules in columns, growing along an axis with five inks in sequence; used full, sparse, clipped to shapes and inside hairline frames; tracked mono labels; gray sheet

units: design units, 1000 = sheet width; the plate is 1000 × 1250

techniques.name: Capsule columns

gap.note: gap as a share of the capsule length

fill.note: chance that a slot holds a capsule

fall.note: phase of the fall; Motion runs it

techniques.limits: Pitch under ~4 u turns the late columns into a solid tint. gap under ~0.1 fuses a column into a bar. A lean past ±30° crosses three columns and the axis stops reading.
techniques.implementation: Each column is filled top to bottom with capsules whose length and width follow the column’s position t on the growth axis; lengths vary ±50 %. A column repeats every panel height, so the fall loops.

techniques.name: Wedge envelope

floor.note: filled share of the height at t = 0

scatter.note: chance of a capsule above the wedge, falling with distance

techniques.limits: floor at 1 fills the panel and the wedge is gone. scatter above ~0.4 hides the wedge edge.
techniques.implementation: The filled height is floor + (1 − floor)·t^power from the bottom; a few capsules are allowed past the edge.

techniques.name: Ink bands on the axis

offset.note: slides the bands along the axis

width.note: gaussian width of each band in t

techniques.limits: width above ~0.35 mixes all five inks everywhere. Under ~0.05 the inks meet in hard stripes.
techniques.implementation: A capsule draws its ink from five gaussian bands along t. Each ink has its own layer; the layers are composited with the variant’s blend.

techniques.name: Shape clip with a masked edge

feather_u.note: width over which coverage ramps down before a clip edge; stippled fields only

params.shapes: rectangle · arch · ring with a gap

techniques.limits: A feather above ~20 u erodes a third of a narrow panel. On flat fields the ramp would show as a gray band, so it is off there.
techniques.implementation: A field is drawn through a clip path. Three erasing strokes along the path then lower coverage toward the edge; the stipple turns that ramp into single pixels.

techniques.name: One-pixel stipple

density.note: share of pixels on at full coverage

fade.note: coverage lost from the head of a capsule to its tail

edge_u.note: blur of the coverage before the threshold; it dissolves the capsule edge

all.note: 1 = stipple every field in every variant

techniques.limits: edge above ~1.5 u dissolves the smallest capsules. density under ~0.5 reads as a tint, not as ink.
techniques.implementation: Capsules are drawn into a coverage layer per ink. Each pixel of the layer is then set fully on or off: on when a random number is under coverage × density.

techniques.name: Capsule helix

node_u.note: diameter of the strand dots at mid depth

phase.note: turns the helix; Motion runs it

techniques.limits: Over ~90 rungs the capsules touch and the helix reads as a ribbon. Under one turn there is no crossing and it reads as a lens.
techniques.implementation: Each rung is a vertical capsule whose length is 2 × amplitude × |sin φ|. Two dots sit at its ends; the near strand’s dot is 45 % larger and the far one 45 % smaller.

techniques.name: Capsule dial

turn.note: turns the dial; Motion runs it

techniques.limits: Over ~120 spokes the inner ends overlap into a ring. lobes at 0 gives a plain sun.
techniques.implementation: Capsules point outward from a circle. Length and width follow a sine with three lobes around the dial; ink follows the angle through the five bands.

techniques.name: Controls from one pill
techniques.limits: Under 24 u height the 11.5 u label touches the pill edge.
techniques.implementation: Button, toggle, three chips, slider, pager and a nine-bar meter are all one rounded bar at different sizes, filled or outlined. The meter reads the slider value.

techniques.name: Capsule icons

scale.note: icon size as a share of its cell

params.set: arrow · plus · menu · signal · pause · check · sun · helix

techniques.limits: stroke above ~10 u closes the gaps in the sun and the helix.
techniques.implementation: Each icon is two to eight straight round-cap strokes on a 2 × 2 unit square; the last stroke takes an ink.

techniques.name: Hairline frame
techniques.limits: Above ~3 u the frame competes with the capsules.
techniques.implementation: The clip path of a panel is stroked once over the field.

techniques.name: Tracked mono label
techniques.limits: Tracking above ~0.4 em breaks words into letters at this size.
techniques.implementation: Capitals in JetBrains Mono, set letter by letter with 0.22 em added; a short rule sits one gap below the last line.

techniques.name: Sheet grain
techniques.limits: Above ~0.06 the grain shows inside the flat inks.
techniques.implementation: A mono multiply grain over the finished sheet.

pass_order: fields · capsules per ink layer, clipped; stippled fields eroded at the clip edge
blend · ink layers onto the sheet
chrome · frames, block, controls, icons, labels
notes: Measured on ref.png: column pitch ≈ 7 px at 1080 px (6.5 u); longest capsule ≈ 84 px; frame rule ≈ 1.3 px; label cap height ≈ 9 px.
Words are invented and plain. The helix, dial, controls and icons are not in the reference; they are built from its capsule.
